text: A dentist I went to regularly when I was on a business trip to Chiang Mai.  There used to be a cafe with a nice atmosphere, but it was closed due to Covid-19 .  I visited for cleaning my teeth for the first time in 3 years, but she continued to treat me carefully.

I was so elated having dental treatments here. The clinic was so clean, equipped with high standard equipment. The dentist was so kind, friendly and very professional. She explained all the problems I had, then organised to finish everything according to plans. I didn’t feel any pain during treatments. She is specialised in Endodontic therapy. The price was reasonable. Better make an appointment as the clinic is usually busy.

Plus after treatments you can sit, relax and have a cup of coffee at Rim Rin Coffee Terrace, located inside of the clinic. I enjoyed having a good coffee with amazing nature scenery. I felt like a holiday with good dental treatments here. Thank you so much. Will definitely come back.

The dental work is excellent, the service is great, the dentist is very kind and friendly, and has a great personality. The price is reasonable. You won't be disappointed. I give it 6 stars! The results exceeded expectations.
author_name: นิพนธ์ ขันแก้ว
